text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! All right! If my research keeps
going this
well, we're golden!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Okay, okay, stay calm. I need to verify
the results
next.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If possible, I'd like to have more test
subjects
than just Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Let's see. There must be some
adventurous
Umamusume around. Time
to start my search.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Just any Umamusume won't be good
enough,
though. They need to have a
physique suitable
for experimentation...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It won't be easy to choose,
but if it's for
the sake
of research...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Come to think of it, it's almost
time for
training.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But that's fine, surely Trainer would be
happier to
see me show up after finding
a new test subject!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Just wait and see, Trainer! We'll be
getting a new
collaborator very soon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And like that, Agnes Tachyon becomes so
preoccupied with her search for a test
subject
that she completely skips out on
training.
